title: Ryoku Settings
description: Canonical declarative settings for Ryoku Desktop (schemaVersion 1). Null means: keep existing Nix/HM/DMS config.

schemaVersion.description: Schema major version. Bump only with a documented migration.

dynamicColors.description: Prefer Matugen/Material You dynamic theming when supported.

wallpaper.description: Basename of a Ryoku-managed wallpaper under assets/wallpapers (installed to ~/.local/share/wallpapers), e.g. "1.jpg". Null = leave wallpaper pipeline unchanged. Absolute /home paths are not used. Live desktop apply — independent of loginWallpaper. Always a static image; kept while wallpaperType is "video" so switching back restores it.

wallpaperType.description: Which desktop wallpaper is active. Null / missing / "image" = appearance.wallpaper (static, DMS). "video" = appearance.videoWallpaper.file rendered by mpvpaper; DMS shows a poster frame used for Material You and the lock screen. Live apply — not projected by Nix.

videoWallpaper.description: Video wallpaper selection and playback options. Null = none configured. Option nulls = defaults.

file.description: Basename of a Ryoku-managed video under assets/wallpapers, e.g. "rain.mp4".

audio.description: Play the audio track. Null = false.

profile.description: economy ≈ 15 fps, balanced ≈ 30 fps, quality = source frame rate. All use VA-API decoding. Null = balanced.

pauseWhenCovered.description: Pause while the wallpaper is hidden (fullscreen window, locked session). Null = true.

visualProfile.description: Shell visual profile. economy = fade-only motion, no blur/shadows; balanced = default motion and blur; cinematic = depth (subtle tilt), stronger elevation and blur (capped over a video wallpaper). Null = balanced. Live: DMS watches this file; not projected by Nix.

shellStyle.description: Desktop shell style. quattro = flat edge-to-edge bar, workspace numbers, opaque cards framed by the Hyprland active-border gradient and grow-from-the-icon motion (after Omarchy Quattro); islands = the floating pill bar of earlier Ryoku. Null = quattro. Projected by Nix on Apply (DMS build, bar layout, Hyprland look).

visualProfileAuto.description: Follow power state: power-saver or battery ≤ 20% → economy; on battery, cinematic → balanced. Event-driven in DMS (UPower / power-profiles-daemon). Null = off.

loginWallpaper.description: Basename of a Ryoku-managed wallpaper for the SDDM login screen. Null = theme embedded default. Projected by Nix on Apply (store path). Independent of appearance.wallpaper. Images only — SDDM never plays video.

transparency.description: 0 opaque … 1 fully transparent where applicable; null = existing config.

apps.description: Application management. Flatpaks declared here are synced via ryoku-flatpak-sync / ryoku-pkg-helper on Debian (Flathub).

flatpakDeclared.description: Flatpak application IDs managed by Ryoku (alphabetical, unique). Debian: Flathub via bootstrap/pkg-helper. Empty array = declare none.

weather.description: Weather widget location. Projected by Home Manager into DMS (session weatherLocation, settings weatherEnabled).

location.description: Place name resolved by the DMS built-in Open-Meteo geocoding, e.g. "City" or "City, Country". Personal value — never a default. Null = weather hidden and never fetched (no fallback city).
